fix: DiscreteSeriesClassification, which says that for every natural number n there are complex inner product spaces H ε lam and maps π ε lam from n by n complex matrices to continuous linear maps of H ε lam with two properties. First, for every ε of type Fin n → Bool and every strictly decreasing lam of type Fin n → ℝ with lam a − (n − 1)/2 an integer for all a, the space H ε lam is complete and nontrivial, π ε lam satisfies IsURepOn (UJset ε), IsIrredOn (UJset ε), IsSqIntOn ε and HasInfChar ε at lam, there is a unique submodule S with IsKTypeOf ε (π ε lam) (lam + rhoN ε − rhoC ε) S, and every μ and submodule S with IsKTypeOf ε (π ε lam) μ S has μ equal to lam + rhoN ε − rhoC ε plus a sum of the terms c a b • root a b with natural numbers c a b that are nonzero only when a < b. Second, for every ε and every complete nontrivial complex inner product space H' with a map σ satisfying IsURepOn (UJset ε), IsIrredOn (UJset ε) and IsSqIntOn ε there are a permutation s of Fin n with s a < s b whenever a < b and ε (s a) = ε (s b), a strictly decreasing mu with mu a − (n − 1)/2 an integer for all a, and a linear isometric equivalence T from H' onto H (ε ∘ s) mu with T (σ (g.submatrix s.symm s.symm) v) = π (ε ∘ s) mu g (T v) for all g in UJset (ε ∘ s) and all v
evidence: The reading gives the first part as a family "with a unique submodule satisfying IsKTypeOf for lam + rhoN ε − rhoC ε" and stops there, while the Lean text adds "∀ (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Submodule ℂ (H ε lam)), IsKTypeOf ε (π ε lam) μ S → ∃ c : Fin n → Fin n → ℕ, (∀ a b, c a b ≠ 0 → a < b) ∧ μ = (lam + rhoN ε - rhoC ε) + ∑ a, ∑ b, (c a b : ℝ) • root a b". The reading also leaves out the condition "∀ a b, a < b → ε (s a) = ε (s b) → s a < s b" on the permutation s and the conditions on mu, and it does not say that it leaves anything out.
